title: 小富即安
concept: 金色旅行箱裹在旅行颈枕和小毯子里
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art for achievement_medal_travel_tier_002, to be converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Create one absurd but premium collectible travel achievement medal for the Chinese title concept "小富即安" (modestly rich and immediately satisfied). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a chunky beveled gold rim and a glossy turquoise enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold travel suitcase happily wrapped in one plush U-shaped travel neck pillow and one tiny cozy blanket, looking so comfortable that it refuses to go farther. The suitcase is the dominant readable shape; the neck pillow and blanket count as one comfort accessory cluster.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, playful deliberate nonsense, premium material finish, raised gold metal, glossy enamel, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: simple large readable silhouette, suitcase centered and dominant, comfort accessories obvious but not cluttered, full medal visible with generous padding, no cropping.
Lighting/mood: warm cozy luxury, bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, smug satisfied "this is enough for me" mood.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold suitcase, electric turquoise enamel, coral or ruby rim accents, one soft cream pillow, one small royal blue blanket, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, soft plush pillow, folded blanket, beveled rim, smooth hand-painted shading. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no camera, no airplane, no seat, no rocket, no globe, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
